constraints: If aTable is omitted, the table of the current form (or subform) is used.

In Design mode, or while DISPLAY SELECTION/MODIFY SELECTION are executing, the automatically-maintained UserSet system set can be used instead; this command remains necessary for subforms (which may highlight records from a different table than the main form) and for non-form contexts (where it returns an empty set).
In included subforms without the Multiple Selection Mode property, this command returns an empty set -- use Selected record number instead to find the selected row.
setName can designate a local/client, process, or interprocess set.
